title: The Elephant-Goldfish Model for software design review: what a fresh reviewer can see
abstract: arXiv:2611.32668v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A design can be easy to understand and still specify the wrong system. Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model asks fresh agents to review a design without the conversation that produced it. We examined how this choice affects detection of omissions, agreement violations and internal defects. We seeded nine defects in each of 47 public software design documents and supplied each with a scripted drafting conversation. A fresh reviewer given the conversation as its own earlier exchange detected 94.8% of omitted-decision instances, compared with 62.4% for the same model given the document alone. It detected 98.3% of violations of conversation-only requirements. On document-visible defects, recall was 87.5% with the conversation and 88.4% without it, equivalent within a prespecified 15-percentage-point margin. translated_title: 软件设计评审的“大象-金鱼”模型：全新评审者能看到什么
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.32668v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个设计可能很容易理解，却仍然规定了错误的系统。Google的“大象-金鱼”模型要求全新的智能体在评审设计时，不接触产生该设计的对话过程。我们研究了这一选择对遗漏项、协议违反和内部缺陷检测的影响。我们在47份公开软件设计文档中每份植入9个缺陷，并为每份文档配有一段脚本化的起草对话。当把该对话作为评审者自身此前的交流提供给全新评审者时，它检测出94.8%的遗漏决策实例，而相同模型仅拿到文档时的检出率为62.4%。它还检测出98.3%的仅存在于对话中的要求违反。对于文档可见的缺陷，有对话时的召回率为87.5%，无对话时为88.4%，在预设的15个百分点等效边际内二者相当。三个模型评审员对检测结果进行评分，并在构建的对照样本上进行了校准。在仅文档运行中，插件的五阶段评审耗时……
tldr: 该研究通过对47份植入缺陷的设计文档进行实验证明，让全新AI评审者接触设计起草过程的对话，可将遗漏决策的检出率从62.4%提升至94.8%，同时不影响文档可见缺陷的检测效果。
en_tdlr: Experiments on 47 defect-seeded design documents show that giving a fresh AI reviewer access to the design drafting conversation raises omitted-decision detection from 62.4% to 94.8% without compromising the detection of document-visible defects.
